title: Workspace typecheck depends on built dist artifacts
reasoning: The root typecheck runs package typechecks with no emit, while workspace packages expose only dist declaration files through their manifests. Downstream packages that import @docgit/core or @docgit/ui will resolve those workspace dependencies through dist/*.d.ts, so a clean checkout without prior build can fail typechecking, and an incremental checkout can typecheck against stale declarations instead of current source.
reproduction: Delete package build outputs such as packages/core/dist and packages/ui/dist, then run pnpm typecheck from the workspace root.
recommendation: Make typechecking source-based or build-aware: add TypeScript project references/build mode, add workspace path mappings for local source during typecheck, or make the root typecheck explicitly generate fresh declarations before checking dependents.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked test or script verifies pnpm typecheck from a clean workspace; the documented full verification runs build before typecheck, which masks the missing-dist case.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI step that removes generated dist directories and then runs pnpm typecheck successfully.
minimumFixScope: Root/package TypeScript configuration plus the root typecheck script.
